source: Instructure Canvas LMS developer documentation, retrieved directly through the web tool; cached full-topic API section.
documented_facts: The full-topic endpoint returns a cached view containing the discussion tree, entry bodies and participants.
unread_entries supplies unread IDs; forced_entries supplies manually forced read-state markers.
The view may refuse access or report unavailable cached content.
Optional new_entries data is a separate flat stream, and the response has an eventual-consistency boundary.
implementation_policy: Ancestor retention, position paths, exact typed identifier association, duplicate-ID refusal for unread focus, and preservation of unmatched markers are this reader's explicit policies. No claim that Canvas itself specifies those ambiguity decisions.
requests: The new API reuses the existing topic and view Canvas GET operations. A configured session broker may carry them in its existing outer transport envelope. No new Canvas write operation is added.
boundaries: No request of include_new_entries and no merge of a separate stream
No assertion that the cached tree is the latest server state
